# Thick & Fit

> Creator-led, bilingual (English/Spanish) fitness coaching app for women, built by coach Stephanie Pantoja. Structured workouts with her filmed demos, low-friction nutrition tracking (photo-to-macro with cooked/uncooked conversion), a living community, and coaching in Stephanie's own method and voice.

## What it is
- Fitness and nutrition coaching for women across the US and Latin America.
- Structured workout programs with Stephanie's filmed exercise demonstrations.
- Nutrition tracking built for real cooking: photo-to-macro, cooked-vs-raw gram conversion, and macro-based meal plans.
- A community feed, challenges, and progress tracking (weight, measurements, photos).
- Fully bilingual: every screen works in English and Spanish, chosen at onboarding.

## Who it is for
- Women who want structured training and nutrition without counting friction.
- Spanish-speaking and bilingual women in the US and Latin America who are underserved by English-only fitness apps.
- People who want a real coach relationship, not an anonymous utility.

## What makes it different
- Bilingual on BOTH sides: the member app and the coaching side both work fully in English and Spanish, not just a translated client app.
- Nutrition built for how Latin and home-cooked food is actually eaten: photo-to-macro estimation plus deterministic cooked-vs-raw gram conversion, so a plate of home cooking can be logged accurately.
- Creator-led: the coaching, meal-plan method, and programming are Stephanie's own, not generic templates.
- Transparent billing: no dark patterns, cancel in one tap, no hidden auto-renew traps.

## Pricing
- Self-Guided: $19.97 per month. Full app access: workouts, photo nutrition tracking, progress tracking.
- Team Thick & Fit: from $200 per month. Everything in Self-Guided plus coaching from Stephanie's trained team.
- 1-on-1 with Coach Steph: premium, by application. Direct personal coaching, limited spots.
- A free trial is offered before any charge.

## Common questions
- Is Thick & Fit available in Spanish? Yes. Every screen works in Spanish or English, and the coaching responds in the member's language.
- How does the food photo tracking work? A member photographs a meal; the app estimates the items and portions, matches them to a food database, applies cooked-vs-raw conversion, and logs real macros. The member can correct any portion.
- How much does it cost? Self-Guided is $19.97 per month; coached tiers start at $200 per month.
- Who is the coach? Stephanie Pantoja, a bilingual fitness coach for women, who built the app around her own coaching method.
- Is it for beginners? Yes. Programs adapt to experience level and available equipment.

## About Stephanie Pantoja
- Bilingual fitness coach for women, founder of Thick & Fit ("Thick & Fit by Steph's Blessed").
- Coaches women across the US and Latin America in English and Spanish.
- Built the app to own her coaching relationship directly rather than run it on a third-party platform.
